title: Simple beam bending and deflection
description_for_llm: Linear elastic (Theory I) analysis of straight beam members. Use for single beams or small beam groups spanning support to support. Assumptions: axis curves in metres, one steel section for all members, self weight active, ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN applied as a vertical point load at every model node, supports at ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS (the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes when the caller does not - for a horizontal beam that pins every node, so pass explicit end supports for a true bending check). Limits: no per-element utilization output, so the validator's strength check falls back to deflection and L/250; no lateral-torsional buckling check. HARNESSED 2026-08-30 from 01_SimpleBeam.ghx via GH_IO XML surgery (tools/harness_frame_capsule.py documents the recipe).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LINES
inputs.description: Beam axis curves, node-merged at shared endpoints.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN
inputs.description: Vertical point load in kN applied at every model node (Unit-Z factor).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions. When omitted the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes; for horizontal beams pass the end points explicitly.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba's Analyse emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
